text:
maya: Quick deploy heads-up — planning to roll console v2.14.0 today during the 14:30-15:00 PT window. Looking for CDN invalidation + smoke-check owners. Can ppl ack and call out any risky UI areas?

alex: I'll take CDN purge and run the fast path smoke. Will run purge at canary then prod after canary looks good. :thumbsup:

priya: I'll monitor frontend errors, session rates, and key user journeys (/login, /dashboard, /workspace). Will put up a grafana panel for quick eyes.

jamal: What's the rollback plan if we start seeing 5xxs or regressions? Also any asset versioning changes I should be aware of?

maya: Rollback plan: 1) Stop rollout, 2) re-point CDN to previous asset hash (we keep previous artifact in s3:/redwood-console/releases/<tag>), 3) trigger cache invalidation for the failed paths. No schema changes. Asset filename bump is single manifest change — we can revert tag.

alex: Purge plan notes: will do targeted purge for `/static/*console-v2.14.0/*` then full site purge if canary fails. Fastly command I use: ```
# purge by surrogate-key
curl -X POST \
  -H "Fastly-Key: $FASTLY_KEY" \
  https://api.fastly.com/service/$FASTLY_SERVICE/purge/some-surrogate-key
```

alex: For Cloudfront we do invalidation: ```
aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id XXXXXX --paths "/static/*console-v2.14.0/*"
```

priya: One more: keep an eye on cache hit ratio for the CDN and on origin 200ms spikes. If origin latency > 500ms for more than 5m, consider rollback.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy started on canary-3 at 14:40 PT (job id: d-7892). Notify #eng-releases on completion.

maya: Can someone verify healthcheck endpoints after canary finishes? I want /api/health, /api/auth/status, and SPA boot to load under 1s in the canary region.

priya: I'll run synthetic checks and a quick manual pass of login + workspace creation. Will paste results here in ~10m.

alex: Canary purge done on canary-3 at 14:44 PT. Assets served from new manifest. Leaving prod purge on hold until smoke OK. :eyes:

priya: Synthetic results: login flow OK, dashboard widgets rendering, trace shows median boot 820ms, 95th 1.2s. No new frontend errors so far.

maya: Good — rolling prod now at 14:55 PT. Alex will do prod purge once we confirm stable for 5m.

deploy-bot: prod rollout started at 14:55 PT (job id: d-7892-prod). Canary -> 50% -> 100% staged.

alex: Prod purge executed at 15:00 PT. Command: `aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id XXXXXX --paths "/static/*console-v2.14.0/*"` — waiting for invalidation to finish.

jamal: Thanks everyone. FYI I have the previous tag ready to redeploy if anything pops. Ping me and I'll revert.

priya: Monitoring 5m post-prod: error rate steady, session creation normal, no regressions on key journeys. Marking smoke pass. :white_check_mark:

maya: Awesome — closing window. Will file a quick release note and tag the rollout in the release tracker. Thanks all for the quick coordination.
